about: What the dashboard shows and why (spec 025; the Status card, spec 026). The Status card shows only what no other card shows: the imaging app and whether alerts go out, plus problems nothing else shows (DS-08). Every field of the status, readings, safety and alerts-armed schemas and every settings-dependency id is mapped here: shown (with a test in web/tests/dashboard.spec.ts) or not shown (with a reason). Checked by tools/dashboard/check.py (DASH-02).

shown.label: dashboard.live
shown.requiredBy: 025 FR-014, 010, 026 FR-002 (amended: Status card shows only what no other card does)
shown.note: The Sky Quality pill (Live, Stale, No updates, Offline). A Status row only while the light sensor has failed and the data is not live.

shown.label: safetyCard.safe
shown.requiredBy: 025 FR-005, 006, 026 FR-002 (amended: Status card shows only what no other card does)

visibility.when: rain stopped but the clear delay holds the verdict
send mode is "only while an imaging app is connected" and Alpaca is off
alerts are on but no enabled channel can send

shown.label: status.imagingApp
shown.requiredBy: 025 FR-009, 021, 026 FR-002 (amended: Status card shows only what no other card does)
shown.note: One tile per Alpaca device: connected, gone quiet or waiting, and when it last checked; one "Alpaca off" tile when Alpaca is switched off.

shown.label: sensor.infrared
shown.requiredBy: 025 FR-006, FR-013, 026 FR-002 (amended: Status card shows only what no other card does)

visibility.when: an expected sensor is not ok

shown.note: Each sensor's own card in its fault state (title and pill); not repeated in the Status card.

visibility.when: the chosen language file is missing, damaged or still downloading after a reload

shown.label: status.clock
shown.requiredBy: 025 FR-016, 005, 026 FR-002 (amended: Status card shows only what no other card does)

shown.label: status.phoneAlarm
shown.demoCannot: The phone alarm needs the Bluetooth build; the demo is the standard build.

visibility.when: the Updates page's last check this session found a newer release

shown.label: sensor.sqml
shown.note: The authoritative sensor's name pill (SQM or SQM-L) on the Sky Quality card; none with one sensor.

shown.label: dashboard.skyDifference

visibility.when: both sky sensors are on, Show other reading is on and the other sensor is ok

shown.note: The other sensor's reading and the Difference (SQM-L - SQM) as two more tiles on the Sky Quality card; the Difference is amber above 1.5 mag/arcsec².

shown.label: dashboard.useSkySensor

visibility.when: the SQM-L is on or chosen and the authoritative sensor is off or not ok

shown.note: The Sky Quality card names the missing authoritative sensor and offers Use <other>; the device never falls back on its own.

shown.label: sensor.sqml

visibility.when: both sky sensors are on and the non-authoritative one answered and then failed

shown.note: A fault card titled with the sensor's name; none for a sensor that hasn't answered since boot.
